user.title: Add a charger
user.description: Find the charger through Tuya Cloud, or enter its local connection details.

cloud.title: Tuya Cloud
cloud.description: Enter the Access ID and Access Secret of your Tuya IoT project. The Smart Life account must be linked to that project.

data_description.access_id: Client ID of the Tuya IoT project.
data_description.access_secret: Client Secret of the Tuya IoT project.

cloud_device.title: Select the charger
cloud_device.description: Choose the charger to add. Its local key is read from Tuya Cloud, then the integration looks for it on the LAN. If the IP cannot be discovered, you will be asked for it.

local.title: Local connection
local.description: The integration tests the connection and detects the Tuya protocol version before creating the entry. This can take up to 30 seconds.

data_description.host: Local IP address of the charger on the same network as Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the local key
reauth_confirm.description: The charger rejected the stored local key. The integration first tries to read the current key from Tuya Cloud. If it cannot, enter the new key.

reconfigure.title: Update the charger connection
reconfigure.description: Change the IP address, local key or protocol version. The current key is read from Tuya Cloud when available.

host.title: Charger IP address
host.description: The charger "{name}" was found in Tuya Cloud, but its LAN IP could not be discovered automatically. Tuya Cloud only reports your public IP, not the charger's local address. Enter its LAN IP address (for example 192.168.1.43), visible in your router's device list or in the Smart Life app.

data_description.host: Local IP address of the charger.

error.cloud_auth_failed: Tuya Cloud rejected the credentials. Check the Access ID/Secret and that your Smart Life account is linked to this IoT project.
error.cloud_no_devices: No device is linked to this Tuya project. Link your Smart Life account to the IoT project, then retry.
error.cloud_timeout: Tuya Cloud did not answer in time. Check your Internet connection and retry.
error.cloud_error: Unexpected error from Tuya Cloud. Retry; if it persists, check the Home Assistant logs.
error.missing_config: IP address, Device ID and local key are required.
error.invalid_auth: The charger rejected the local key. Copy the current key from Tuya IoT Platform or Smart Life and retry.
error.cloud_key_invalid: Tuya Cloud returned a local key that the charger rejected. Check that the device is linked to the right Smart Life account, or enter the new key manually.
error.cloud_key_unchanged: Tuya Cloud returned the same local key as the one already stored. Update the key in the Smart Life app or Tuya IoT project, or enter the new key manually.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the charger on {host}:6668. Check the IP, that the charger is powered on and on the same network as Home Assistant.
error.port_busy: Port 6668 is already used by another client. Close Smart Life or the Tuya app on your phone, then retry.
error.unsupported_device: The charger answered, but its Tuya profile is not supported yet. Open an issue with the model and data points.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while connecting. Check the Home Assistant logs.
error.timeout: The charger did not answer within 45 seconds. Check that it is powered on and reachable on the local network, then retry.

progress.title: Dé EV Charger
progress.cloud_devices:
Connecting to Tuya Cloud and fetching your devices…

This usually takes a few seconds, 45 seconds at most.
progress.identify_charger:
Looking for the charger on the local network…

Listening for its Tuya announcement, then scanning the LAN and testing an authenticated connection. This can take 15 to 30 seconds.
progress.test_connection:
Testing the connection to {host}…

Detecting the Tuya protocol automatically (3.5, then 3.4 and 3.3). This can take up to 45 seconds.
